title: The Six Triple Eight clears the war mail
summary: The 855 women of the 6888th Central Postal Directory Battalion cleared an estimated 17 million undelivered letters and packages in three months, then tackled years-old mail in France.
why: Restored mail contact between soldiers and their families.

unsung.contribution: Sorted a backlog of about 17 million pieces of soldiers' mail in half the expected time.
unsung.recognition: There was no public recognition at the time; a Congressional Gold Medal came only in 2022.
